cron_five_fields: use 5 fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week
cron_missing: cron is not installed on this machine (apt install cron)
cron_other_install: the scheduler cron belongs to another NetOps installation ({owner}); this one does not overwrite it — tasks here do not fire on their own
invalid_github_as: github_as must be the ID of a console user
invalid_kind: type must be script, agent or hybrid
invalid_notify: notification must be auto, always, failure or never
invalid_permissions: permissions must be restricted or full
invalid_schedule_type: schedule type must be cron, interval or once
name_ambiguous: name '{name}' is ambiguous — use the id
no_nested_tasks: a scheduled task cannot create other tasks
prompt_required: describe what the agent must do
